adjudication.rationale: In `db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb`, the migration loops over existing `embeddable_hosts` values from `site_settings` and runs `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"` (lines ~25-27). Because `h` is interpolated directly into a single-quoted SQL string with no escaping/quoting helper, any host containing a `'` will break the SQL (or worse, alter the statement). This is a real, diff-verifiable correctness/data integrity issue in the migration.
